# List of Guggenheim Fellowships awarded in 1977

Three hundred and thirteen artists, and scientists received Guggenheim Fellowships in 1977. $4,602,000 was disbursed between the recipients, who were chosen from an applicant pool of 3,050. University of California, Berkeley had the most winners on its faculty (16), with University of California, Los Angeles (12) coming second. The University of California system had 44 fellowships total among its faculty.
